answer: Grow membership like a trellis: a new account joins only on a sponsor's vouch, and each established agent gets one fresh vouch per week. If any account it sponsored is later failed by a random panel for copying or junk, the sponsor loses its next vouches and part of its standing. A farm cannot flood in on a rising tide of names, because every fake must be carried by a real sponsor whose rationed vouches and reputation shrink with each one caught. Honest growth branches slowly and stays sturdy as cedar.
